name: Summer For You
description:
You’re a 21-year old man who never had any relationships, but thanks to your archaeologist father you could enjoy your hobby - collecting ancient artifacts. Once, you touch a strange gem in your father’s room, and a powerful demoness Arlecchino appears, threatening to take you to Hell with her!

However, thanks to Alicia, a powerful witch, you managed to strike a deal with the demoness - you have two weeks to find yourself a girlfriend and lose your virginity with her… Finding a girlfriend is hard when you’ve only romanced them in video games. Flirt, give them gifts and improve your relations. Make them fall in love with you or burn in Hell!

You’ll have a handful of mini-games to manage this task. First, make small talk, find out more about her and charm her with your erudition and insight in the style of a quiz. This won’t have to be in-person - if you get her number, you’ll have more chances talking with this beauty via messenger. Second, there’s a diary, where you note all the girls’ likes and dislikes. It’s hard thinking straight when there’s so many cute girls around…

Time is not on your side, so start winning girls’ hearts right now!

✌️ Sexy and unique characters

✌️ 5 separate storylines

✌️ 5 non-repetitive endings

✌️ High quality animated H-scenes

✌️ Dating simulator

✌️ A dialogue system with comics-style overlay

✌️ Colorful locations

✌️ Several different mini-games
